articles.summary: AI-generated blog posts read familiar for a reason: they share a shape. A 13,500-post study separates the two by structure alone with a detection score of 98.0 out of 100, and rewording does not move it. The ten features behind it, and what human writing does differently.
articles.title: How to Tell AI Slop From Human Writing: Ten Structural Features From 13,500 Blog Posts
